name: refactor_node_fs_promises
description: Migrates nested fs callbacks to fs/promises async-await
prompts: copytext.js implements copyTextFiles with three levels of nested fs callbacks and hand-rolled completion counting. Refactor it to modern style: export an async function copyTextFiles(srcDir, destDir) using require('fs').promises (or 'fs/promises') and await, which resolves to the number of .txt files copied and rejects on error. Same behavior: destDir created recursively, only names ending in .txt copied, non-txt files ignored, empty source resolves to 0. Remove the callback parameter entirely - the export is promise-based now.
